messages.subject: unmarked 0.8-8
parts:
unmarked 0.8-8 is now on CRAN, although it might take a few more days for the Mac version to be ready. This release contains some important bug fixes related to gmultmix() and multinomPois(). There are also some new features and documentation improvements. The release notes can be found here, and the revision history is here. Comments and suggestions are welcome.

Richard
